content: Hello all, new member. Has anyone implemented enforced provenance across a large project where membership in a list proves exhaustive coverage? I’m new to lean so been using AI to help me write the code but am looking for examples of prior work to compare and make sure it’s correct.

Basically forcing the value, calculation, object, to show it has a valid history. For my case especially, I’m using lean to show that derivations down stream have a valid upstream. If their upstream is invalid it won’t compile.

I'm still not sure what you're asking about. You're talking about being able to have a declaration and then do some transformations or calculations with it and track the sequence of transformations applied to it alongside your results? An example would help for what you are asking about.
